definitions.explanation: The act of calling out numbers or names, typically at restaurants, clinics, or service counters to notify customers that their turn has come.
Being called or summoned to appear somewhere, often by an authority figure or institution.

examples.japanese: {呼|よ}び{出|だ}し⟦ベル→ベル：01379_beru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{呼|よ}び{出|だ}し⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We will call you by number.

examples.japanese: {呼|よ}び{出|だ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧お⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please wait until you are called.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{呼|よ}び{出|だ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I was summoned by my boss.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{呼|よ}び{出|だ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{呼|よ}び{出|だ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じた→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧。
examples.english: I responded to the summons from the police.

notes:
{呼|よ}び{出|だ}し has everyday uses (waiting for service) and more formal uses (being summoned). In restaurants and clinics, {呼|よ}び{出|だ}し⟦ベル→ベル：01379_beru⟧ (pager/buzzer) is commonly used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {呼|よ}び{出|だ}し⟦ベル→ベル：01379_beru⟧ (pager, buzzer)
- {呼|よ}び{出|だ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive a summons)
- {呼|よ}び{出|だ}し⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧ (call number)
